true

Wolf ! My wolf ! The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !

Did you enjoy talking to him?
How did your conversation with him go?
Poor Otak... How did that go?
I'm glad you finally met. Otak can be a little hard to explain.
You met Otak? Oh boy... How did that go?
I did. Though perhaps I wanted to weep for it. For he introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
He... introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
I found him nothing but sweet and charming ! But buried beneath a layer of humor, I felt great heartbreak.
Yes, I would think so. A child's scrawl written on the back of an automaton. I found him nothing but sweet and charming !
Why do you sound less than pleased that I met him ?
Greeting me in the same unflinching, cheerful way he had the previous times. But he knew me as a Sœur de Sol !
Не расскажешь ли мне историю бедного Monsieur Отака?
But buried beneath the humor, there is great heartbreak.
He can get on my nerves sometimes, is all.
I didn't mean to. He can just be a little... off putting for some people.
I'm sorry. He can get on people's nerves sometimes. It's not his fault.
Indeed, he knew much of the Luminaries ! We talked at length of the "Ancient Religions" as he dubbed them, in the "days before the Orokin Empire."
Раньше Отак был архимедиан, учёным и академиком Орокин. То, что с ним произошло, нельзя назвать особенно радостной историей.
I would hope you would seek to be more kind with someone who is clearly infirme. Mais par la grâce de Sol, go we all.
And I would hope they would show him kindness and patience. Mais par la grâce de Sol, go we all.
Though he said much of that knowledge was lost now, deep in the archives, and very much forbidden. He swore me to secrecy.
Судя по всему, он был гением и умом, стоящим за освоением кристаллов аргона.
Such a fate could wait for any of us. Even you.
He told me that he was deeply concerned that Executor Ballas - whoever he may be - might discover my sect of heretics and have me executed.
Которые извлекаются из Бездны, именно благодаря им мы можем создавать множество мощных варфреймов и оружия.
You're right, I'm sorry. I didn't mean that.
I just don't have the time to spend on him, I'm sorry.
Ballas is dead... keep going.
That... won't happen. Keep talking.
Он специализировался на кристаллографии. И его труды были сохранены здесь, в лабораториях.
Then I am sorry for wasting more of it.
+5 Chemistry
По какой-то причине, я не знаю, его превратили в Цефалона и дали ему собственную некралоидную оболочку.

I suspected... Well, he asked me where I was from, and when I told him, he laughed and said "no, that's impossible! And I should know, I'm -"
Не все Цефалоны были созданы в наказание. Но здесь, на Деймосе, дела пошли... плохо, и он был серьёзно повреждён.
Chat ends.
And then he... introduced himself to me again. And asked me if I was coming from the plains with mineral samples...
Pauvre petit...
Yeah... that's Otak.
Oh, Marie. I'm so sorry...

It shatters me into a million pieces to think there is nothing to be done for him.

Why leave him there, broken and waiting until he is allowed to die to be given peace? I can only pray... that if there is some kind of presence there -
And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
That no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
It is because he remains by choice as some kind of lonely vigil...
Because if you are wrong, and a soul remains within that cage against its will ?
Or if there is some kind of presence there, it is because he remains by choice as some manner of lonely vigil.
To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
It is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?

Ha ! Merci. That is sure to stop these foolish tears of mine. You do know how to cheer silly little Marie, non ?
Oui. You are quite right. They are. The world is full of no end of stories like that of Monsieur Otak, and many far worse than his. I should not weep over one.
